title: Weighted GPA Methodology
overview: Weighted GPA adds bonus points for advanced courses (Honors, AP, IB) to recognize course rigor. Schools use this for class rank and college preparation assessment.

methods.name: Standard Weighting System
methods.description: Add 0.5 points for Honors courses and 1.0 points for AP/IB courses to the standard 4.0 scale.

formula.name: Course Weighting
formula.expression:
Regular: A=4, B=3, C=2, D=1, F=0
Honors: Add +0.5 (A=4.5)
AP/IB: Add +1.0 (A=5.0)

Weighted GPA = Σ(Weighted Grade × Credits) / Σ(Credits)

limitations: Colleges often recalculate on their own scale
methods.bestFor: High school class rank, rigor recognition

footnotes: Not all schools weight grades - some use unweighted only
Taking harder classes with lower grades may hurt GPA but shows rigor
Colleges consider both weighted and unweighted GPA
